title.narrative: Promoting citizen participation to local governance and peace in Goma/North-Kivu Province

description.narrative: The DRC, considered as a post-electoral country, remains fragile with weaknesses in democratic governance, decentralization and restoration of state authority. In the area of justice and security, DRC is facing corruption and impunity, breakdown of the state and absence of rule of law. Citizen participation in local governance continues to remain a major concern for women and youths. Project plans to increase their awareness and engagement on civic participation, to enhance their interactions with officials and hold them to be more accountable. EAC/Goma Diocese will ensure that project activities planned give opportunity to inhabitants to experiment their citizenship in positive way, they have their voice heard by municipalities’ authorities and participate in democratic debate as key actors. The frameworks for consultation and dialogue will be set up at various levels in the targeted municipalities to physically bring local authorities and elected officials closer to the communities and enable them to interact. The restructured local governance committees will systematically channel the grassroots needs collected in municipalities for appropriate advocacy actions and monitoring of population access to basic services.
